text: Today my manager was telling me I am doing very good job. First time in this company. I am feeling very much proud.
Missing my family in Kerala so much. Here nobody is knowing my name properly. Everybody says it wrong.
Visa interview tomorrow morning. Not able to sleep. All documents I have checked five times only.
Finally passed the IELTS with 7.5! Called Amma and she was crying on phone. So happy today.
Landlord is again not fixing the heater. Three weeks I am asking. In this cold. Very angry now.
Rainy Sunday, made chai, called nobody, did nothing. Quite peaceful actually.
My colleague Dmitri is always making jokes about my accent. Others are laughing. I am also laughing but inside not.
Thank you god for this job. After eight months searching, finally something. Grateful for every small thing today.
So many forms for the residence permit. Each office sending me to other office. My head is spinning.
Went to the Diwali event at community hall. Met people from my state. Felt like home for few hours.
Working double shift for sending more money home. Body is not having any energy left.
Lucía from language class invited me for dinner with her family. They were so warm. I am not feeling foreigner tonight.
I am thinking a lot, is it right decision to come here? Money is better, but life is less. Don't know.
My daughter is speaking English better than me now. She is correcting me in shop. I am proud and little bit sad also.
Bus was late, train was late, I was late, boss was not happy. Bad bad day.
Next month my parents are coming for visiting! First time in three years. Cleaning the flat already.
Nobody to talk in my language here. Sometimes I am talking to myself in Tamil only to hear it.
Passed the driving test in first attempt! The examiner was also smiling. Feeling like king today.
The doctor is not understanding what I am explaining. I am not understanding what she is explaining. Very frustrating.
Today I am content. Small room, but warm. Good food, phone call with Appa. Enough.
My hands are shaking. The court is deciding about my asylum next week. Everything depends on this.
Neighbour old lady is giving me apples from her tree every week. She is not speaking my language but is very kind.
Hopefully this new course will help me get better job. Classes start Monday. Bought new notebook.
Ramadan alone in new country is very different. Breaking fast by myself in kitchen. Missing the noise of home.
My son got the scholarship. All the sacrifice is worth it now. I am crying happy tears.
I am so much tired of explaining where I am really from. I am from here also now.
Man in supermarket shouted 'go back to your country' at me. Still shaking. Why people are like this.
Cooked biryani for my flatmates. They are asking for recipe! Little victory.
Long day of interviews. Three companies. All are saying 'we will let you know'. Waiting now.
Very calm today. Went to the lake after work, sat on bench, watched ducks. No thinking.
So many things happening: new job, moving flat, wife's pregnancy, papers for the bank. I am not able to think straight.
Thinking of my father today. He died when I was here and I could not go. Still this is hurting.
The tea lady at office, Mrs. Begum, is always asking how is my mother. Small thing. Means a lot.
I got the permanent residence!!! After six years! I want to tell everybody on the street!
Today nothing special. Work, gym, dinner. Okay day.
Nervous for presentation in English in front of whole team. I am practising whole night.
My English teacher Ruth said my writing is improving very fast. Feeling hopeful that one day I can write like native.
Housemates are having party again until 3am on work night. I am asking politely many times. Now I am angry.
Cleaned the whole flat, did laundry, cooked for the week. Feeling good, everything in order.
Watching old video of my wedding back home. Everybody dancing. Some of them now not alive. Heavy heart.
The bank refused my loan because I am not here long enough. Every door is closing. What I am supposed to do.
Am I becoming different person in this country? My friends back home say I am talking differently. Thinking about it.
First snow of my life today!! I went outside in slippers like small child. Neighbours were laughing at me.
Grateful for video calls. I am seeing my nephew grow even from far away.
Too much tired for writing today. Only: shift was twelve hours.
Lonely in the evenings mostly. Daytime is okay with work. After 7pm the room is very quiet.
Got promotion to team leader. Me, who could not speak English properly five years ago. Who is laughing now.
Hoping my brother's visa will be approved this time. Second application. Praying.
Kenji from the factory is teaching me to fish on Sundays. We don't speak much. It is peaceful.
The officer at immigration was so rude to my mother at airport. I am still boiling.
Is it normal to feel happy and guilty same time? I am enjoying my life here while family is struggling.
Tomorrow is citizenship ceremony. I bought a new suit. Cannot believe this day is coming.
Fixed the bicycle myself watching videos. Small things I am learning here alone.
The children at the school are asking my daughter why she is wearing hijab. She came home very quiet.
Life is slowly settling. Job is stable, flat is nice, I have two friends now. Feeling content.
I cannot sleep thinking about Ammi's operation back home. I am so far. If something happens I cannot reach.
Thank you to the volunteer at the food bank, Tom. He helped me fill the forms in simple English.
Weekend I am working, weekdays I am studying. No time for anything. Too many responsibilities.
Went for interview, waited two hours, they said position is filled already. Wasted whole day.
Paid the rent, bought groceries, sent money home. Balance is zero but everything is paid.
The landlady invited me for Christmas dinner. First Christmas I am not alone in this country.
I am feeling hopeful. Small steps every day. One day this will feel like home.
Somebody stole my bike from outside the station. The only thing I own here that cost money. Very sad and angry.
Sunday market with Aisha and her kids. We are buying vegetables and laughing at prices. Simple happiness.
My boss is shouting at everybody but specially at me. I think because I am not answering back. Feeling small.
Tired but satisfied. Finished night school course with distinction. Certificate on wall.
So much paperwork for registering the baby. Two languages, three offices, one crying baby.
Looking at the sky tonight and thinking same moon is over my village. That is giving me some peace.
In ten days I will see my children after two years. I am counting the hours.
I think I am finally understanding British humour. Laughed at a joke in meeting at right time. Big moment.
